statement.zh: 阿克苏姆石碑原巨型石碑是非洲晚古纪念碑传统的核心物证（Littmann DAE；UNESCO 15）。
statement.en: Aksum’s giant stelae are core material evidence of an African late antique monumental tradition (Littmann DAE; UNESCO 15).
